'''Ov Darum''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] on [[Citadel Station]] after the [[Jedi Civil War]]. By [[3951 BBY]], Darum was the champion of the swoop track on the station.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
